WITH filtered_web_sales AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_order_number, ws_sold_date_sk, ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998) AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
),
filtered_customer_address AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
),
cd1 AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
),
cd2 AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College'
)
SELECT 
    substr(r_reason_desc,1,20) AS reason_substr,
    avg(ws_quantity) AS avg_ws_quantity,
    avg(wr_refunded_cash) AS avg_wr_refunded_cash,
    avg(wr_fee) AS avg_wr_fee
FROM 
    web_sales ws
JOIN 
    web_returns wr ON ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
JOIN 
    reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN 
    customer_address ca_refunded ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
JOIN 
    filtered_web_sales ws_filtered ON wr.wr_order_number = ws_filtered.ws_order_number AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws_filtered.ws_item_sk
JOIN 
    cd1 ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN 
    cd2 ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
WHERE 
    (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND ws_filtered.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
    OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND ws_filtered.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
    OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND ws_filtered.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 250.00)
GROUP BY 
    r_reason_desc
ORDER BY 
    reason_substr, avg_ws_quantity, avg_wr_refunded_cash, avg_wr_fee
LIMIT 100
